title: Natural Spawner Cleaner
description: It removes all natural spawners, THIS WILL NOT WORK ON PREGENERATED CHUNKS. This will NOT remove player placed spawners.
body: My first plugin, sorry if it doesn't meet your standards. Donut SMP based plugin, removes all naturally generated spawners, good for custom spawner plugins that don't work with natural ones. Also good for Donut SMP based servers.
